resources.string: Photograph a place, like the bathroom sink
Without a registered photo, taking any photo dismisses the alarm. Register one of a place away from your bed, for example the bathroom sink, so you have to get up and go there.
Point the camera at a place away from your bed with a few objects in view. A bare wall or tiles can\'t be recognised. The photo stays on this phone.
Too little detail to recognise this later. Try a view with more objects, or turn on the light.
Matches from farther away or in dim light
Stand where you took it, with the light on
Stand where you took the photo and point the camera the same way.
Too dark: turn on the light or the flashlight.
This mission needs the camera to compare what it sees with your photo. Only the registered photo is saved, on this phone.
